notes: WHAT'S NEW IN 4.1.9: (1) VIDEO PLAYER REMOVED — music MP3 only, on the user's order: the video player, MP3|Video toggle, Music Videos / Fresh Punjabi Videos rows, search Videos tab and floating mini-video are all gone. YouTube stays as a search + account source, audio only. (2) YOUTUBE SE ADD KARO — Search → YouTube tab: search YouTube and tap a result to add it as a song, it plays its full audio. Search runs through the ytsearch API (https://ytsearch.suryajasoos-4fe.workers.dev) with an 8s cap, and falls back to the BeatBox server and JioSaavn when it returns nothing or is slow — the results always say which source they came from, never a silent empty list. (3) SIGN IN WITH GOOGLE — the YouTube tab has a real Google sign-in (OAuth + PKCE) for your liked songs, playlists and subscriptions. Needs your own Google OAuth Client ID, pasted in the YouTube tab — setup steps are in the project README. Until it is pasted, the app says so honestly and never pretends to be signed in. (4) NO DEPLOY NEEDED — 4.1.9 works fully without the beatbox-api Worker; the Worker stays optional (Settings → Music Backend shows its status). (5) OPTIMISATION — home skips its live searches on launch when the cache is fresh (< 6h), images decode async, smooth scrolling. Kept from 4.1.8: screen-off playback, tap motion, player buttons, Refresh All Data, karaoke lyrics, permissions, background survival. NOTE for 4.1.5 users: the in-app download can stick at 0% on 4.1.5 — if it does, tap Cancel and install the APK file sent in chat, it updates the same app.
